items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: he threatened Walter, who was the owner of the club

ctx.x: Well, he came by then and he threatened Walter, who was the owner of the club; he threatened Walter, that he was going to have some signs put out front and pickets walking in front of the place if the club didn't go union.

Now, we got to join the union. Well, I think the piano player and myself was the only two that wasn't union, but the rest of the guys were union, and they were working a non union gig, and Redman couldn't say anything to them about it, you know?
